body.name: Off-model target-local block-constrained least-squares map
body.construction: Fix \(E_0\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), and \(j\in V\). Put \(P_{E_0j}=\operatorname{pa}_{G_{E_0}}(j)\). Let \(A_{E_0j}\) have rows \(i\in P_{E_0j}\), columns \(B\in\Pi^{E_0}_j\), and entries \((A_{E_0j})_{iB}=\mathbf 1\{i\in B\}\). For a nonempty parent set define \(\Gamma_{E_0j}(\Sigma)=A_{E_0j}^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_{P_{E_0j},P_{E_0j}}A_{E_0j}\), \(h_{E_0j}(\Sigma)=A_{E_0j}^{\mathsf T}\Sigma_{P_{E_0j},j}\), and \(\beta_{E_0j}(\Sigma)=\Gamma_{E_0j}(\Sigma)^{-1}h_{E_0j}(\Sigma)\). Repeat each block coefficient on its member parents and put zero outside the parent set to obtain \(L_{E_0}(\Sigma)\); use a zero row for an empty parent set.
